question: Which Indian Naval Ship participated in the 50th Independence Day celebrations of Papua New Guinea and took part in the Military Tattoo at Port Moresby in September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Kadmatt.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **INS Kadmatt participated in Papua New Guinea’s 50th Independence Day celebrations, with the Indian Navy Band performing at the grand Military Tattoo in Port Moresby.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Navy Band performed martial tunes and Indian melodies, showcasing India’s cultural ethos.**
 
• The event brought together bands from several nations, symbolising unity and shared heritage.
 
• INS Kadmatt’s crew also paid homage at Bomana War Cemetery, honouring WWII heroes, including Indian soldiers.
 
• The visit highlighted maritime bonds and India’s commitment to friendship with Pacific nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Vikrant__

 __
 
• India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, commissioned in September 2022.
 
• Symbol of India’s naval self-reliance.
 
 
 
• INS Kolkata__
 __
 
• Lead ship of the Kolkata-class stealth guided-missile destroyers.
 
• Commissioned in 2014, based at Mumbai under Western Naval Command.
 
 
 
• INS Shivalik__
 __
 
• India’s first indigenously built stealth multi-role frigate.
 
• Commissioned in 2010 and part of the Eastern Naval Command.
 
 
 
• INS Kadmatt__
 
 
• Second ship of the Kamorta-class anti-submarine warfare corvettes.
 
• Commissioned in January 2016, named after Kadmat Island in Lakshadweep.
 
• Played a key role in strengthening maritime diplomacy through cultural and ceremonial engagements.
